import numpy as np

def magnitude_pruning(weights, sparsity=0.5):
    flat = np.abs(weights.flatten())
    threshold = np.percentile(flat, sparsity * 100)
    mask = np.abs(weights) > threshold
    pruned = weights * mask
    actual_sparsity = 1 - np.count_nonzero(pruned) / pruned.size
    return pruned, mask, actual_sparsity
